attribution_semantics.detector: start from local c2-free detector solution; release each nuisance individually and finally all configured nuisances

guardrail: This is a local compensation/identifiability diagnostic, not a physical attribution of the residual to a TES parameter. A nuisance parameter that recovers fit quality when c2 is removed may simply be correlated with another missing transfer or detector-model term. Magnicon cutoff/Q and white are frozen within each day to isolate detector-nuisance compensation.
